ruleNotes.react-doctor/jsx-no-jsx-as-prop: False positives in Server Components: JSX props are static RSC composition, not client re-render churn. The remaining client case is tracked separately by code review if it reappears.
ruleNotes.react-doctor/iframe-missing-sandbox: YouTube embeds require allow-same-origin for the player; SOP still prevents app DOM access and the component documents the sandbox tradeoff inline.
ruleNotes.react-doctor/no-array-index-as-key: src/lib/text.tsx renders deterministic fragments from static split() output; the sequence is not reordered, inserted, deleted, or filtered by user data.
ruleNotes.react-doctor/no-array-index-key: Same deterministic text-fragment rendering as no-array-index-as-key; index keys are stable for this static split output.
ruleNotes.react-doctor/server-sequential-independe: The admin user edit page intentionally awaits the authorization gate before fetching protected data; parallelizing would fetch data for unauthorized requests. Additional concurrent work may surface the same rule and should be triaged before re-enabling.
ruleNotes.react-doctor/no-event-handler: Disabled after triage: current hits are false positives on derived constants such as isEdit/isEditMode/actionToUse, not event side effects hidden in useEffect.
ruleNotes.react-doctor/no-cascading-set-state: Disabled after triage: remaining hit is already a consolidated useReducer transition state in NosotrosModal, not multiple independent setState calls.
